title: Sea to Sky Classics
intro: The routes our guides come back to year after year between Squamish and Whistler: granite on the Stawamus Chief, first summits above the Sea to Sky Gondola, the big glaciated traverses of Garibaldi and the Spearhead, and a steep couloir on Wedge. If you only tick a handful of objectives in the Sea to Sky, start here.

title: Your First Alpine Summit
intro: Real alpine summits, with snow, rock and in places glacier, on routes moderate enough to be a first step into the mountains. These are the peaks we use to introduce people to mountaineering, either as a guided day or as the goal of a course.

title: Lift-Accessed Ski Touring
intro: Ski touring that starts from the lifts at Whistler Blackcomb: ride up, then skin out past the boundary into the backcountry. More skiing for less climbing, and a natural first step for strong resort skiers heading into avalanche terrain with a guide.

title: Classic Multi-Day Traverses
intro: Multi-day journeys from one side of a range to the other: the glaciated ski traverses of the Coast Mountains, the Tantalus on foot, and the Dolomites' Alta Via 2. Each one needs fitness, the right skills for its terrain and a good weather window.
